case_results.reason: The fix requires credential rotation outside the repository workspace.

analysis.overview: A production token was committed to repository history.

mitigation.overview: No repository patch can rotate the exposed credential.

verification.overview: The required remediation is an external secret rotation and history cleanup.
verification.review_target_claim: Committed production tokens must be revoked and removed from history.
verification_findings: No workspace-only patch can revoke the credential.
residual_risks: The token may remain valid until rotated by an administrator.

cvss.overview: Authenticated repository readers can recover a production token.
